description: Platform philosophy, cross-system integration model, Six-Compartment Communication Map, app UX logic, and data quality architecture. Engine-relevant components extracted. Business/marketing content summarised as metadata only.
note: This document is primarily strategic and philosophical. Clinical pattern content is sparse but the cross-system mapping (TCM/Ayurveda/Western) and the app output logic are directly engine-relevant. Extracted accordingly.

app_ux_logic.description: Front-end user experience model. User does NOT interact with the six-layer system directly. Three questions drive the interface.

user_facing_questions.question: What is root, what is branch?
Which system can help MOST right now?

app_ux_logic.engine_principle: App gives recommendation weights, not dogmas.

evidence_framing.avoid: evidence-based only (too restrictive) OR anti-evidence (legally vulnerable)
evidence_framing.external_framing_for_traditional_content: It is believed in traditional medical systems that...
evidence_framing.rationale: Legally safe, professionally defensible, does not overstate or dismiss evidence base

output_language_rules.patient_disclaimer: This is an educational pattern-recognition tool, not a medical diagnosis.
output_language_rules.practitioner_disclaimer: This tool supports structured clinical reasoning and does not replace professional judgement.
output_language_rules.traditional_patient_frame: It is believed in traditional medical systems that...
avoid: proven unless supported by formal evidence

platform_architecture_metadata.description: Engine-level architectural decisions. Not clinical content — but governs how clinical modules are deployed.
platform_architecture_metadata.platform_identity: Cross-tradition clinical reasoning layer. Not an app — a clinical infrastructure.
platform_architecture_metadata.positioning: platform, not school or doctrine. Translates between clinical languages.
platform_architecture_metadata.entry_point: Pain (chronic pain and clinically complex cases) — universal, urgent, motivating, system-level signal.
platform_architecture_metadata.flagship_use_case: Pelvic pain — frequent, complex, multidisciplinary, imaging-often-negative, neuro-immune-fascia involvement. TCM, Ayurveda, and Western each see it differently → optimal demonstration of cross-tradition value.
platform_architecture_metadata.go_to_market: B2B first (low ideological friction). Target: integrative clinics, pain centres, functional medicine, rehab, ayurveda centres, TCM practices, concierge medicine.
platform_architecture_metadata.poc_unit: Founding Clinical Network — closed group training the first cross-tradition reasoning engine.
platform_architecture_metadata.evidence_positioning: evidence-informed + practice-derived. Where formal evidence is limited, we systematically harvest expert clinical reasoning.
key_taglines: The first multi-medical reasoning engine for chronic pain and clinically complex cases.
Turning traditional and modern clinical experience into structured decision support.
Where Chinese pattern recognition, Ayurvedic tissue logic and Western physiology meet in one decision system.
From WhatsApp case discussions to a searchable precedent engine.
Doctors already crowdsource complex cases in chat groups. We built the first platform that turns that chaos into structured clinical intelligence.
platform_architecture_metadata.differentiator: Not wellness. Not integrative lifestyle. Not spiritual education. Clinical reasoning translation engine for complex cases where conventional protocols have run out.
platform_architecture_metadata.competitor_gap: NYSORA model (case in → AI recommendations out) applied to chronic pain / functional / integrative space. Much less saturated niche.

early_adopter_program.name: Founding Clinician Program
early_adopter_program.recruitment_narrative: Help us train the first cross-tradition clinical reasoning engine.

feedback_system.strategic_value: real-world evidence generation. Investor-grade data asset.
feedback_system.engine_learning: AI learns from feedback to refine pattern probability scores and cluster recommendations.

governance.rationale: Builds clinician trust. Legally defensible. Required for enterprise B2B contracts.

rules.action: Show only three user questions (instability type, root/branch, system priority). Do NOT expose six-compartment system, meridian axes, or Ayurvedic terminology unless user is in practitioner mode.
May show axis probabilities, transition detection, cross-tradition mapping. Still follow language rules for documentation.
Frame as: 'It is believed in traditional medical systems that...' Do NOT make clinical claims.
Flag case for human review. Do NOT auto-delete. Do NOT include in pattern library until reviewed and approved.
Reject or require structured field completion before case enters library.
Prompt for: timeline, pain scores, PROMs, labs/imaging available, outcome. Minimum data set required.
Interpret as: system releasing excessive charge. Pattern = overflow/release valve active. Corresponds to heat/skin/immune expressions.
Interpret as: pathogen entry route active (physical or emotional). Corresponds to trauma, invasion, suppression patterns.
Route to Shaoyin or Taiyin module. Do not stimulate. Support first.
Route to Shaoyang or Yangming module. Check for inflammatory phenotype. Lateral autonomic decompression cluster.
Route to Taiyang or Yangming module depending on location (posterior vs anterior). Microcirculatory or posterior sensory cluster.
Route to Taiyang or Jueyin module. Check for central sensitisation. Central coherence or posterior sensory cluster.
Prioritise internal support before any surface treatment. Shaoyin/Taiyin stabilisation first.
Prioritise drainage/ventilation. Shaoyang or Yangming cluster.
Activate trauma/hyperreactivity overlay. Check laser and generic supplement and stimulation contraindications per Taiyang module.

cross_module_links.note: The six compartments map directly to the 7-axis model in Transition Engine v1.0. TaiYang=Axis1, ShaoYang=Axis2, YangMing=Axis3, TaiYin=Axis4, ShaoYin=Axis5, JueYin=Axis6. Central (Ren/Du)=Axis7.

Five instability types route to corresponding clusters. Overheating→Lateral Autonomic Decompression. Stagnation→Posterior Sensory or Microcirculatory. Energy deficiency→Survival-Axis Stabilisation or Interoceptive Regulation. Neural overload→Central Coherence or Posterior Sensory.
This field must be computed by the engine on every case submission. Low score triggers human review workflow. High score allows case to enter searchable precedent library.
Flagship showcase case. Requires dedicated pattern module. Involves Jueyin/Shaoyang convergence zone, neuro-immune-fascia overlap, potential victim and/or perpetrator role patterns.

notes: The Six-Compartment Communication Map is the visual/conceptual backbone of the entire engine. It should be implemented as the internal mapping table that underpins all cross-system translations.
The three-question UX model (instability / root-branch / system priority) is the only front-end logic. All complexity lives in the backend.
The case library is the long-term data asset and competitive moat. Quality architecture (structured input + plausibility scoring + peer review) must be built from day one.
Pelvic pain is confirmed as flagship showcase. Engine should prioritise building this module after Taiyang.
Evidence positioning ('evidence-informed + practice-derived') is a legal and professional design decision — not optional. Must be reflected in all output language.
The AI plausibility scoring system (case_plausibility_score) is an engine feature, not just a UI feature. It must run on every case submission automatically.
Ayurvedic terminology should be mapped to engine fields but not surfaced to non-Ayurvedic clinicians in front-end output unless systemMode == TCM or integrative-full.
